title: Platinum Reserve Account: Same-day transfers and wire capabilities
summary: This document explains Platinum Reserve Account capabilities for same-day ACH, wire transfers, and external bank transfers: same-day ACH is available for time-sensitive disbursements; outgoing domestic wire transfers cost $0; external bank transfers process in 0 business days. It also provides operational guidance (confirm recipient details/beneficiary instructions, maintain recipient libraries, use payment notes, and keep dual approval/risk controls).
